## Task: Verify response-cache header-key pause with deterministic red-green evidence

Verify the approved fix with identical pinned baseline/fixed inputs. Combine focused automated checks with a real Envoy/proxy-Wasm Redis barrier harness, repeated causal hit/miss/error/timeout assertions, machine-readable results, stable public evidence URLs, hashes, and cleanup proof.

### Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Record exact BASELINE_SHA and FIXED_SHA, patch range, OS and architecture, Go and Docker/Compose versions, pinned builder and gateway image references, and immutable image digests
- [ ] Build baseline and fixed Wasm modules with the same pinned Go 1.24.5 builder and record both SHA-256 values
- [ ] Run go test ./... -count=1, go test -race ./... -count=20, go vet ./..., the wasip1 Wasm build, sha256sum, and git diff --check on the exact fixed head
- [ ] Run the same rendered Envoy, plugin, Redis fixture, upstream fixture, request, CPU, and timing configuration for baseline and fixed variants through a real proxy-Wasm data path
- [ ] For baseline and fixed, run three independent rounds of 50 sequential barrier-controlled hit requests with unique IDs and assert causal Redis/upstream ordering, client status/headers/body SHA-256, upstream counts, zero panics, and zero transport errors
- [ ] On the fixed variant, run repeated barrier-controlled miss and asynchronous RESP error cases and assert exactly one resume, exactly one upstream arrival, client completion, and no duplicate forwarding
- [ ] Run the dedicated lower-cache.timeout case with a withheld Redis response; record whether the host returns a timeout callback or leaves the request paused until the client deadline, and verify the documented fail-open or operational fallback without overstating the boundary
- [ ] Publish a sanitized stable GitHub-accessible evidence bundle containing the harness, rendered configuration, fixtures, requests, machine results, ordered event logs, client responses, Envoy/plugin/fixture logs, rerun and cleanup commands, and SHA256SUMS
- [ ] Prove cleanup leaves no test containers, networks, volumes, listeners, or processes
- [ ] Before marking this TASK done, update its canonical summary and checklist with every exact command/result, evidence URL, artifact hash, rerun result, limitation, and the final exact head

### Execution Planning

- Owned modules / write areas:
  - N/A; verification must not modify production source and may use an isolated temporary harness plus a separately reviewed public evidence location
- Shared touchpoints:
  - plugins/wasm-go/extensions/response-cache/** as read-only build and test input
  - wasm-runtime-verification/** as read-only harness reference
  - TASK-4569001 exact baseline and fixed revisions
- Dependency / interface assumptions:
  - TASK-4569001 exact implementation head
  - Approved #4569 Verification Plan
  - Pinned Go builder and Higress gateway/Envoy image by immutable digest
  - Docker/Compose access and a deterministic RESP-compatible fixture
- Coupling class: serial after implementation; results must compare the exact baseline and fixed heads with identical inputs
- Recommended execution mode: one bounded verification worker after maintainer authorization and implementation exact-head handoff
- Complexity / split guidance: large runtime-evidence task; keep one causal harness so baseline/fixed inputs cannot drift
